note: Each of the 11 Hokom _scg_gate() calls is classified against the canonical SCG P0-P12 ladder from Saleh/Qiyas. The gate labels (NORMALIZE, SEGMENT, etc.) are Hokom-internal stage identifiers, NOT canonical SCG candidate names.
gate_function: _scg_gate(source, target) in hokom_pipeline.py — calls TaaqolJudgmentEnforcer; returns None (continue) or stopped-result dict on hard stop

gates.SCG_CANDIDATE_CORRESPONDENCE: None — 'NORMALIZE' and 'SEGMENT' are not SCG candidate types
gates.ACTION: KEEP — legitimate internal gate enforcing Taaqol judgment before clitic segmentation
gates.SUGGESTED_LABEL: HOKOM_GATE_01: pre-normalization → post-segmentation (covers pre-P0 through P1 clitic decomposition)
gates.NOTE: Gate fires before segment_token() executes; enforces fail-closed judgment at segmentation boundary. No correspondence to a named SCG candidate transition.
Fires before mabni/functional/jamid boundary stages; enforces judgment before atomic normalization.

gates.SUGGESTED_LABEL: HOKOM_GATE_03: atomic normalization → boundary type decision (OPERATOR/MABNI/JAMID_AALAM)
gates.NOTE: Covers OPERATOR_BOUNDARY / MABNI_BOUNDARY / JAMID_AALAM_BOUNDARY determination before root admission.

gates.SUGGESTED_LABEL: HOKOM_GATE_04: boundary decision → root-candidate engine (P2 registry-projection entry)

gates.SCG_CANDIDATE_CORRESPONDENCE: None — sub-phases within P4 JamidMushtaq domain
gates.SUGGESTED_LABEL: HOKOM_GATE_06: wazn projection → bab/paradigm projection (P4 internal)

gates.SCG_CANDIDATE_CORRESPONDENCE: None — bab → masdar projection; sub-phase within P4-P5 region
gates.SUGGESTED_LABEL: HOKOM_GATE_07: bab projection → masdar projection (P4-P5 internal)
HOKOM_GATE_08: masdar projection → derivative classification (P4-P5 internal)

gates.SCG_CANDIDATE_CORRESPONDENCE: JamidMushtaqCandidate (P4) → MufradWordCandidate (P5) — first meaningful SCG mapping
gates.ACTION: KEEP — highest SCG correspondence confidence in the Hokom gate set
gates.SUGGESTED_LABEL: HOKOM_GATE_09: JamidMushtaq closure → word-class determination (P4→P5 entry)

gates.SCG_CANDIDATE_CORRESPONDENCE: Within P5 MufradWordCandidate: word-class classification → paradigm/inflection

gates.SCG_LAYER_APPROXIMATE: P5 → P6+ boundary (Hokom terminal → Saleh/Qiyas entry)
gates.SCG_CANDIDATE_CORRESPONDENCE: MufradWordCandidate (P5) terminal in Hokom; P6 VerbalSignifiedCandidate requires Saleh/Qiyas
gates.SCG_MAPPING_CONFIDENCE: HIGH — this is the actual Hokom/SCG cross-repository handoff gate
gates.ACTION: KEEP — critical boundary gate. P5 is the last layer Hokom can produce. P6+ belongs to Saleh/Qiyas.
gates.SUGGESTED_LABEL: HOKOM_GATE_11: MufradWordCandidate (P5) → Taaqol SGA / Saleh-Qiyas P6+ handoff boundary
gates.NOTE: This gate's name TAAQOL_SGA is correct: it marks the boundary where Hokom hands off to Taaqol judgment enforcement. The P6-P12 continuation is Saleh/Qiyas territory; Hokom cannot satisfy it.

reclassification_summary.critical_finding: No Hokom gate label corresponds to a canonical SCG P0-P12 candidate name. The gates guard Hokom-internal morphology stage transitions, not SCG candidate-chain transitions. Gate_11 (PHASE_5→TAAQOL_SGA) is the sole cross-repository handoff point.
reclassification_summary.naming_contamination: Use of '_scg_gate' as function name creates false impression that Hokom gates ARE the SCG P0-P12 gate mechanism. They are Hokom-internal enforcement points that happen to invoke TaaqolJudgmentEnforcer before each stage transition.
